QuestInfo.name: 2nd Acclimation Training
QuestInfo.0: I shall receive the 2nd Acclimation Training from #b#p1102000##k.
QuestInfo.1: This time, the monster in question for Acclimation Training is #r#o9300272##k. I'll need to enter #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k and battle against #o9300272#... \n\n#o9300272##r #a207021##k

0.0: Okay, are you ready to take on the next training session? I'm sure #p1101002# told you this already, but if you talk to #p1101001#, you'll be divinely blessed, which will help you go through the training that much easier. If you forgot to do so, then go get it right now. Are you ready?

yes.0: This time, the targets are #r#o9300272#s#k, which are monsters you'll run into quite often in Victoria Island. Honestly, I've never been there, so I don't know if that statement is legit.
yes.1: You'll see a lot of the #o9300272# dummies I've prepared for you in the #b1st Drill Hall#k as before. Get #r20#k of them.

no.0: If you forgot something, then I suggest you take care of that first before going off to battle. There's nothing worse than looking for an item in the heat of the battle, only to realize you left it at home.

1.0: Wow! You defeated 20 of the #o9300272# dummies? Things are moving a long quite nicely. Let's have you train one last time. Talk to me when you're ready.

mob.0: Hm, doesn't seem like you defeated #r20 #o9300272##k dummies yet. You didn't go all the way out to Victoria Island to find them, did you? All you have to do is enter the #b1st Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest.
